About Me

Hello World! Let me tell a few things about me...

BIO

My name is Leevi. I am a tech and computer enthusiast from Tampere Finland. So no wonder I ended up studying information technology in Tampere University. I have four years of working experience as a fullstack web developer.
I like building scalable products with great user experience. I am always up for new learning opportunities and chances to put my current knowledge in use to solve real life problems with by developing well built software solutions.

Tampere University

BSc and MSc in Information Technology

I started my studies in 2016 and got my bachelor's degree in 2021 and my master's degree in 2024. I studied programming and software development as my major subject. During my studies I also worked in positions related to software development.

Tampere University, Faculty of Medicine and Health Technology

Back-End Developer

I was in a project group that was developing a prototype of a centralized patient monitoring system. My responsibilities were to implement the back-end for the application using technologies such as Node.js and socket.io. I was also responsible for the system testing of the product.

Adalia Ltd

Fullstack web developer

I am working as a fullstack developer to develop and maintain ERP systems mainly using Ruby-On-Rails and ReactJS. I am also doing some React Native mobile development. My responsibilities are designing and implementing new features to the systems based on customer requirements.
